senses.gloss: to slap (with the palm of the hand); to strike.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 79:6">Yalk. Gen. 79</cite> <he>קְפָחַתָּהּ</he>, v. <cite ref="I00636"><he>טָפַח</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 15:2:2">Y. Yeb. XV, 14ᵈ</cite> <he>אין החמה קוֹפַחַת על וכ׳</he> the sun strikes the head of man only in the harvesting season.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6">Cant. R. to I, 6</cite> <he>קְפָחַתּוֹ החמה על וכ׳</he> the sun struck his head, and his face became bronzed.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67:11">Gen. R. s. 67</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 27:46">Gen. XXVII, 46</cite>) <he>קופחת זו לזו וזו לזו</he> slapping this against that, and that against this’ i.e. (cmp. <cite ref="N01251"><he>נָקַשׁ</he></cite>) believing all of them equally bad.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 20:5:2">Y. Sabb. XX, end, 17ᵈ</cite> <he>קפוח</he>, v. next. w.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 23">Gen. R. s. 23</cite> (ref. to <he>וזה</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 11:6">Gen. XI, 6</cite>) <he>ק׳ על ראשו וכ׳</he> he put his hand upon Nimrod’s head, saying, this man &c.; <cite ref="Genesis 11:6">ib.</cite> s. 26.

<cite ref="Pesachim 118a:20">Pes. 118ᵃ</cite> <he>הקב״ה איֹנו מְקַפֵּחַ שכר וכ׳</he> the Lord does not outrage (by withholding) the reward of any creature, i.e. even the wicked are rewarded for what good they may do; <cite ref="Nazir 23b:11">Naz. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>אין</he> … <he>מקפח אפי׳ שכר וכ׳</he> God does not withhold the reward even for a decorous word. Y. Dem. I, 22ᵃ <he>איפשר … והוא מְקַפְּחוֹ במים</he>(= <he>מק׳ שכרו</he>) is it possible? he honored his Creator with water, and he should outrage him with water (allow his daughter to be drowned)?; Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ bot. <he>מקפתו</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Kiddushin 52b:13">Kidd. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>לקַפְּחֵנִי בהלכות וכ׳</he> they come to overwhelm me with citations of traditions (of which they will prove me to be ignorant); <cite ref="Nazir 49b">Naz. 49ᵇ</cite>.

Num. R. s. 9 (31) קִיפְּחָה נזירות בראשה she forced the nazarite obligations upon her head (the vow was of her own doing); a. fr.—Part. pass. מְקוּפָּח; f. מְקוּפַּחַת forced, perverted, distorted. Y. Sot. III, 18ᵈ bot. נמצאת מידת הדין מק׳ justice would appear perverted; Num. R. l. c. Ohol. XVI, 1 אקפח … שזו הלכה מק׳ may I bury my children (v. infra), if this is not a distorted (misrepresented) hălakhah; Tosef. ib. XV, 12.

senses.gloss: to overpower, take from one by force. Y. Snh. VIII, 26ᵇ bot. יושב … ומקפח הבריות וכ׳ he will sit at cross-roads and rob the people and kill &c.; (Bab.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 72a:1">ib. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>ומלסטם</he>); <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30:6">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>ומק׳ לעוברים ושבים</he>.

<cite ref="Yoma 83b:11">Yoma 83ᵇ</cite> <he>קִפַּחְתָּ את הרועה</he> thou hast forced the shepherd (to give thee his bread); <he>אני קִפַּחְתִּי … ואתה קפחת וכ׳</he> I laid the shepherd under contribution, but thou didst so to the whole town (when they all came to his rescue with refreshments).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 3:1">Pesik. R. s. 3</cite> <he>ראה כמה קי׳ לוט וכ׳</he> see to what extent Lot deprived Abraham of the divine communication!; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to cover, bury, survive. Ohol. l. c.; Y. Sabb. XVI, 15ᶜ bot. אֲקַפֵּחַ את בניי וכ׳ may I bury my children if &c. (an oath frequently used by R. Ṭarfon).
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 85a:14">B. Mets. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>אותו צדיק שהיה מקפח את בניו</he> that righteous man (Ṭarfon) who used to swear by the life of his children.
<cite ref="Pesachim 87b:9">Pes. 87ᵇ</cite> <he>אין לך כל נביא … שלא ק׳ וכ׳</he> there was not a single prophet that did not survive four kings &c.; a. fr.—Trnsf.
<cite ref="Shabbat 147b:10">Sabb. 147ᵇ</cite> <he>חמרא … קִיפְּתוּ וכ׳</he> the wine of P’rugitha and the baths of D. (luxurious life) ruined ten tribes of Israel.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:14">Kidd. IV, 14</cite> (<cite ref="Kiddushin 82a">82ᵃ</cite>); Tosef. ib. V, 15 <he>קיפחתי את פרנסתי</he> I have ruined my livelihood (forfeited the privilege of support without toil like dumb animals); Y. ib. IV, end, 66ᵈ (not <he>קופחתי</he>).—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Keritot 5a:101">Ker. 5ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>קלט את הריח וקִיפְּחוֹ</he> the oil resorbed the scent and retained it; <cite ref="Horayot 11b:7">Hor. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>קולט … וקפחו</he> (ed. Ven. <he>וקופיחו</he>; corr. acc.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 387">Yalk. Ex. 387</cite> (not <he>וקיפחן</he>).
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: (denom. of קִפֵּחַ) to make high and arched shoulders, to cause or pretend to be humpbacked.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 8:6">Sot. VIII, 6</cite> <he>כל המבקש … לקַפֵּחַ את שוקיו</he> if anybody attempted to go back (desert the army), he (the officer) was empowered to beat him until he was humpbacked; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 198">Sifré Deut. 198</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 923">Yalk. ib. 923</cite>. Tosef. Peah lV, 14 <he>המקפח את שוקיו</he> (a beggar) who simulates a hump; <cite ref="Ketubot 68a">Keth. 68ᵃ</cite>; Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵇ top <he>המנפח</he> (read: <he>המְכַפֵּחַ</he>).
